scope: GEO catalog metadata; file payloads, biological independence and cross-assay pairing not verified

title: Histone modifications in lung epithelial cells
overall_design: We performed Mint-ChIP (ChIP-seq for low cell number samples) using antibodies for H3K4me3, H3K27ac, H3K36me3, H3 and p53)
type: Genome binding/occupancy profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: H3K4me3 ChIP-seq CTGF-pos epithelial cells after Bleomycin treatment Replication 1
source_name_ch1: alveolar epithelial cells induced by Bleomycin treatment
treatment_protocol_ch1: 2.5 U/Kg bleomycin was administered intranasally and mice were monitored daily. Mice were sacrificed at day 12 after bleomycin injury.
extract_protocol_ch1: For sorting AEC2 cells from Mki67-tagRFP mice, cells were stained with CD31, CD45, CD326 and lysotracker then CD31-neg/CD45-neg/CD326-pos/Lysotracker-pos/tagRFP-neg cells were sorted. For sorting CTGFpos cells from CTGF-GFP mice, cells were stained with CD31, CD45, Lgals3, CD326 then CD31-neg/CD45-neg/Lgals3-neg/CD326-pos/GFP-pos cells were sorted.
Extraction of DNA, ChIP reactions and library constractions were performed uisng Mint-ChIP3 protocol (https://www.protocols.io/view/mint-chip3-a-low-input-chip-seq-protocol-using-mul-wbefaje)
data_processing: A pipeline called MintChIP was used (https://github.com/jianhong/MintChIP)
